name: PT OBM Drilchem Tbk
summary: Globally, PT OBM Drilchem Tbk manufactures and supplies specialized additives essential for the drilling fluids industry. In addition to its product offerings, the company provides a comprehensive range of on-site and remote services. These include devising tailored technical proposals and solutions for specific well conditions, delivering engineering and training expertise, and offering custom product design services. Established in 1996, PT OBM Drilchem Tbk maintains its headquarters in Jakarta, Indonesia.
